channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Renan Santos atinge 10% nas pesquisas, mas propostas heterodoxas geram debate
item.description: Renan Santos, MBL coordinator, reached 10% voter intention in recent polls, but his government plan is facing criticism for proposing heterodox and eccentric measures. The rise in popularity contrasts with the debate sparked by proposals outside traditional political consensus.

item.title: Em reunião com diplomatas, Flavio Bolsonaro ataca urnas eletrônicas com acusações já desmentidas pelo TSE
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, repeated discredited claims by the TSE against Brazil's electronic voting machines, alleging ties to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic and citing an alleged CIA report on election fraud in Venezuela. Despite stating he was not questioning Brazil's voting system, he called for more foreign election observers in the 2026 elections. The remarks were made during the 'Debating Brazil' event with representatives from nearly 50 countries.

item.title: Governo aguarda definição dos EUA sobre tarifa adicional
item.description: The Brazilian government is awaiting a U.S. decision on a potential additional 12.5% tariff on Brazilian products, on top of a 25% tariff set to take effect on July 22. The outcome, expected by July 24, could alter Brazil’s export scenario and guide executive actions, including diplomatic negotiations and market diversification efforts, such as an upcoming official mission to India. Officials called the U.S. measure unjust but emphasized continued dialogue with productive sectors and evaluation of proposals to mitigate economic impacts.

item.title: Biden brasileiro? Aliados de Lula avaliam proibir petista de participar de debates
item.description: Allies of the Lula government are considering banning the president from participating in televised debates during the first round of the 2026 elections, aiming to preserve his image and prioritize grassroots agendas. The proposal comes from government strategists and advisors aligned with the PT’s pragmatic wing, which views the debate marathon as a risky endeavor. The goal is to avoid exposure that could wear down the candidate against opponents.

item.title: Dino manda notificar estados e municípios que não prestaram contas de ’emendas Pix’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has ordered the direct notification of states and municipalities that failed to account for 'Pix amendments' allocated to the events sector between 2020 and 2024, imposing a daily fine of 1% of the transferred amount on entities violating transparency rules. The measure aims to enforce penalties for omissions or incomplete submission of Work Plans and Management Reports in the Transferegov.br system, based on AGU data showing 21 plans without reports, 19 with partial reports, 40 in completion phase without registration, and 9 with inconsistent or incomplete documentation.

item.title: Eduardo diz que vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio “demonstra imaturidade”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro called Michelle Bolsonaro's video criticizing Flavio Bolsonaro and PL party deals an act of 'immaturity,' stating that internal disputes over presidential candidacy are natural but should remain private. He added the incident reflects right-wing mobilization and hope for a more conservative election, but such matters should be resolved internally.

item.title: Flávio cita informação falsa sobre empresa venezuelana e urnas ao pedir a diplomatas que enviem 'observadores' ao Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged foreign diplomats to send election observers to Brazil's 2026 elections, citing false claims about Venezuelan company Smartmatic interfering in Brazil's electronic voting system. He referenced CIA documents released under the Trump administration, which do not confirm large-scale electronic fraud in Venezuela, to support his request. The remarks were made at the 'Debating Brazil' event in Brasília, attended by representatives from 42 countries.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG sobre a disputa pela Presidência
item.description: The Nexus institute released a new presidential voting intention poll for 2026, commissioned by BTG Pactual, based on 2,000 interviews with a two-point margin of error. In the previous round (July 13), Lula led with 40%, six points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (34%), while Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado trailed. The poll will also measure approval of Lula’s government and voter reaction to the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian imports.

item.title: “Se não me demitir, o demitido é ele”, diz Eduardo sobre ministro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro, former federal deputy and son of ex-President Jair Bolsonaro, warned that Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva risks being dismissed if he does not approve the PF’s recommendation to fire Eduardo for abandonment of duty. Living in the U.S. since February 2025 with a green card granted by Trump, Eduardo claims he is fleeing political persecution but wishes to return to Brazil when conditions allow.

item.title: Em encontro com embaixadores, Flávio resgata episódio que tornou Bolsonaro inelegível e diz que pai 'apenas manifestava preocupações' com sistema eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) recalled in English, during a meeting with ambassadors, that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, was declared ineligible for having held a similar meeting in 2022, where he raised unfounded suspicions about Brazil's electronic voting system. He corrected his statement, clarifying that the former president is ineligible — not imprisoned — due to the abusive use of state structure and TV Brasil to spread electoral disinformation before foreign diplomats. Flávio stated he does not question Brazil's electronic voting machines but advocates for greater international observer presence in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: candidatos a presidente poderão gastar até R$ 133,4 milhões em campanha, define TSE
item.description: The TSE set spending limits for the 2026 elections, maintaining the same values as in 2022. Presidential candidates may spend up to R$ 88.9 million in the first round and an additional R$ 44.5 million if there is a runoff, totaling R$ 133.4 million. Limits vary by office and state, based on the R$ 4.9 billion Campaign Finance Special Fund and Election Law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leva informações falsas sobre urnas em reunião com embaixadores e repete o pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) spread false information about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors in Brasília, repeating claims previously made by his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted in a coup plot. The incident occurred on Tuesday (21st) and reignites concerns about electoral misinformation in Brazil.

item.title: Escritório de gestão da mudança amplia engajamento em 73%
item.description: The implementation of a Change Management Office (CMO) by a Brazilian energy company, in partnership with SMR Consultoria from November 2025 to April 2026, increased employee engagement by 73% through a structured methodology (RUMOS) that integrated change management into project governance. Involving 12 areas and approximately 100 professionals, the initiative standardized communication, training, leadership support, and risk monitoring, enabling knowledge transfer across transformation initiatives.

item.title: Javier Milei deve discursar em evento que lançará Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência, diz Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho stated that Argentine President Javier Milei is expected to speak at the event launching Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy, scheduled for Saturday in São Paulo. The PL party is seeking alliances with PP, União Brasil, and Republicanos to strengthen the ticket, though no vice-presidential candidate has been named yet, with a decision expected by August 5. Marinho also noted that Flávio Bolsonaro was not previously prepared for a presidential run, but the campaign is now gaining organizational traction.

item.title: Por que Tereza Cristina recusou a ideia de ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) declined the invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate in the 2026 presidential election, stating she intends to run for Senate President in 2027. She aims to succeed Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), the current Senate President, after distinguishing herself in opposition to Lula's government, notably in the rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF.

item.title: Partido Comunista é suspenso pelo TRE-DF e pode ficar fora das eleições
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District (TRE-DF) suspended the regional directory of the Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) due to non-compliance with the 2023 financial reporting, blocking access to party and electoral funds and preventing the party from nominating candidates in the 2026 elections if the suspension remains in effect at the time of the party convention.

item.title: A troca de farpas entre Caiado e Eduardo Bolsonaro sobre green card
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Eduardo Bolsonaro's green card, stating that Brazilian producers deserve permanent U.S. visas to strengthen agribusiness and protect jobs. Eduardo Bolsonaro replied, accusing Caiado of ignoring farmers condemned for the January 8 acts and granting Goiás citizenship to STF ministers and the Attorney General, implying Caiado would serve those elites if elected.

item.title: Investigada no caso INSS aciona STF por suposto vazamento de áudios para campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The defense of businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger has asked Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça to investigate an alleged leak of audio obtained through illegal wiretapping in the INSS fraud investigation, claiming that Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign plans to publish the recordings for electoral gain against President Lula. Lawyers state they have no knowledge of any judicial authorization for the wiretap and demand immediate access to the case files, as well as the opening of an investigation into the illegal breach of telecommunications secrecy. Mendonça is expected to refer the request to the Prosecutor General's Office for analysis on Wednesday (22).

item.title: Tereza Cristina nega vaga de vice na chapa de Flávio, diz Valdemar
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) declined the invitation to be the running mate for presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), according to PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto. The party is seeking a woman from a Centrão-aligned party to fill the vice-presidential slot, but has not yet settled on a name.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio diz que Michelle é candidata ao Senado ‘até agora’: ‘Temos interesse’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign coordinator, Senator Rogério Marinho, stated that Michelle Bolsonaro is still being treated as the PL's Senate candidate, despite her growing distance from the presidential hopeful. He confirmed she was invited to the party's national convention and that her attendance remains uncertain, but the party continues to value her candidacy due to her national relevance. Marinho also noted that the choice of vice-presidential candidate depends on ongoing negotiations with the Centrão, with Daniella Marques as the leading contender, though formal party support from Republicans is not guaranteed.

item.title: Com vice do PL, PSD lança Dr. Furlan ao governo do Amapá
item.description: The PSD officially launched Dr. Furlan's candidacy for governor of Amapá, with state deputy Luciana Gurgel (PL) as his running mate. Furlan, former mayor of Macapá, was removed from office in March by a STF decision in Operation Paroxismo, which investiges suspected fraud in health-related procurement, a matter he denies. Although the Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office challenged his eligibility due to an ongoing case regarding alleged abuse of economic and political power in the 2024 elections, the TRE-AP dismissed the precautionary action, allowing his candidacy to proceed.

item.title: Ambientalistas pressionam Lula a vetar projeto que reduz em quase 40% a Floresta Nacional do Jamanxim, no Pará
item.description: Environmentalists are urging President Lula to veto a bill that would reduce the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará by nearly 40%, converting it into an Environmental Protection Area with weaker safeguards. The bill, passed through accelerated legislative process, is seen as threatening Lula’s environmental legacy and Brazil’s zero-deforestation goal.

item.title: Rogério Marinho: Convidaremos Milei para discursar em convenção do PL no sábado, 25
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) announced that the PL party will invite Argentine President Javier Milei to speak at the party's national convention on Saturday, the 25th, in São Paulo. Marinho is the political coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ).

item.title: Eduardo diz que vídeo de Michelle foi desnecessário e prova imaturidade
item.description: Former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) criticized the video in which Michelle Bolsonaro publicly exposed a fight with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling it 'unnecessary' and saying it demonstrates the former first lady's immaturity. The statement was made today, reflecting internal tensions within Bolsonarism. Eduardo suggested such public exposures harm the family and political unity of the group.

item.title: Kirchner contrata advogado brasileiro para defesa internacional
item.description: Former Argentine president Cristina Kirchner has hired Brazilian lawyer Rafael Valim for her international legal defense, in collaboration with Spanish jurist Javier Borrego. Valim, an expert in administrative law with experience in international human rights tribunals, will work to appeal alleged violations of due process and fundamental rights in her corruption conviction. Kirchner denies the charges and claims she is a victim of political persecution.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro rebate Ronaldo Caiado após crítica sobre green card
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro rebutted Ronaldo Caiado after the former governor criticized the use of his green card for tourism, arguing it should benefit Brazilian producers competing in the U.S. market. Eduardo mocked Caiado's silence on the 'farmers condemned in the Disney golpe,' referencing the January 8 events and implying Caiado favors ties with the STF and Brasília elite over national interests. The exchange unfolded on social media, with Eduardo noting his green card was granted by the Trump administration and that he intends to return to Brazil.

item.title: Plano de governo de Renan Santos propõe 'desfavelização', guerra ao crime organizado, fusão de municípios e fim do Bolsa Família
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, unveiled a radical government plan proposing municipal consolidation (from 5,570 to ~1,600), eradication of favelas within a decade, construction of maximum-security prisons, replacement of Bolsa Família with paid work programs, and a fiscal amendment to decouple pensions from the minimum wage, aiming to save R$1.1 trillion by 2031. Inspired by Nayib Bukele’s El Salvador model, the plan emphasizes security, fiscal austerity, and administrative centralization.

item.title: PL convidará Milei para discursar em convenção de lançamento da candidatura de Flávio
item.description: The PL has invited Argentine President Javier Milei to speak at its national convention in São Paulo, where Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy will be officially launched. Milei will also hold a private meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro and São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas before the event, as part of a strategy to reinforce the narrative of alignment between Brazil’s right and conservative Latin American leaders. The visit follows the failed attempt by Milei to meet jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro, whose social visits were blocked by the STF.

item.title: Como os derrotados das eleições passaram a negar a democracia
item.description: The article discusses how political leaders in various countries — including Donald Trump in the U.S., Jair Bolsonaro in Brazil, Gustavo Petro in Colombia, Roberto Sánchez in Peru, and Daniel Ortega in Nicaragua — have questioned or rejected electoral results, often based on unfounded conspiracy theories, threatening democracy. It notes that while social media were initially hoped to foster rational dialogue and consensus, they have instead amplified extremist and isolationist ideas, contributing to the erosion of trust in democratic institutions.

item.title: Lula autoriza uso das Forças Armadas nas eleições de 2026
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva authorized, through a decree published in the Official Gazette, the use of the Armed Forces to ensure voting, vote counting, and logistical support in the 2026 elections. The measure aims to guarantee security and the orderly conduct of the electoral process.

item.title: Caiado critica 'green card' para Eduardo: 'Quem precisa é o produtor brasileiro para entrar no mercado americano'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Eduardo Bolsonaro's acquisition of a U.S. green card, arguing that such residency should be granted to Brazilian farmers to access the American market without tariffs. He linked the comment to Trump-era trade policies and emphasized strengthening Brazil's agribusiness as a national priority over individual benefits.

item.title: Luiz Marinho é a favor de Senado aprovar 6 X 1 como passou na Câmara
item.description: Labor and Employment Minister Luiz Marinho voiced support for the Chamber-approved PEC that changes the work schedule from 6X1 to 5X2 and reduces the weekly workload to 40 hours, urging the Senate to pass the identical text without amendments to avoid sending it back and speed up approval. He emphasized ending the 6X1 schedule is a key government priority and part of Lula’s re-election strategy, while expressing frustration over the prospect of delaying the vote until after the October elections, stating it is 'hard to talk to those who do not want to talk'.

item.title: Ao deixar TV Globo, ex-BBB anuncia pré-candidatura, mas ‘esconde’ partido
item.description: Former Big Brother Brasil contestant Vivian Amorim announced her pre-candidacy for state deputy in Amazonas, departing from TV Globo to enter politics. She stated that her political journey is a personal calling tied to social causes, particularly supporting mothers, children, and the elderly. Vivian confirmed her affiliation with the center-leaning União Brasil party and clarified she is currently in the pre-campaign phase, awaiting her party’s convention for formal candidacy validation.

item.title: Eduardo rebate Caiado após postagem sobre ‘green card’
item.description: Former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro countered a post by former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado, who had mocked Eduardo’s green card approval. Eduardo replied that the benefit should go to 'farmers condemned in the Disney coup,' referencing a conservative conspiracy theory about election fraud. The exchange on X was reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Sob fogo interno, PT lança #porquepatrus para justificar candidato escolhido ‘com delay de 20 anos’
item.description: The PT launched the #porquepatrus video to justify Patrus Ananias as its candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, emphasizing his record as a UN-awarded mayor of Belo Horizonte, former Minister of Social Development, and creator of Bolsa Família. The choice faced criticism from within the party and online, labeled as outdated and uncompetitive, with critics referencing the failed administration of former PT governor Fernando Pimentel, which ended with 18% approval and widespread salary arrears.

item.title: Plano de Lula para quarto mandato põe arcabouço fiscal na berlinda e Planalto enquadra Gabrielli
item.description: Lula's campaign for a fourth term is facing internal divisions over economic policy, particularly after remarks by José Sérgio Gabrielli, who advocated for capital controls and a higher minimum wage, causing discomfort within the PT and the Ministry of Finance. The Planalto stepped in to contain the fallout, stating that Lula is the sole spokesperson for his program and that there will be no abrupt or unpredictable economic measures.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: a Lei Rouanet para presídios
item.description: On Papo Antagonista, the proposal by presidential candidate Renan Santos of the Missão party to apply the Rouanet Law in prisons was discussed. Based on the Movimento Brasil Livre's Yellow Book, the idea is to use tax incentives to fund cultural projects within the prison system. The 51-page plan was described as original and creative by the show's participants.

item.title: Lula se reúne com Paes e petistas para fechar palanque no Rio
item.description: Lula met with PT and PSD leaders in Brasília to solidify his electoral slate in Rio de Janeiro, with Eduardo Paes (PSD) as gubernatorial candidate and Benedita da Silva (PT-RJ) running for Senate. The ticket also includes Pedro Paulo (PSD-RJ) and Eduardo Cavalieri (PSD), the current mayor of the capital. The goal is to secure a first-round victory to weaken Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), whose electoral base would then be isolated.

item.title: Eduardo diz que Michelle agiu com imaturidade e não deveria ter postado vídeo com críticas a Flávio
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro for posting a video with criticisms against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, calling her reaction immature and inappropriate. He argued that publicizing family dissatisfaction undermines the Bolsonaro clan's unity in the political landscape.

item.title: Postulante 'anti-Moro' ao governo do Paraná acusa o senador de interferir em partido para esvaziar sua candidatura
item.description: Former state deputy Tony Garcia (PR) accused senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) of interfering in the Christian Democracy (DC) party to block his candidacy for governor of Paraná, claiming Moro co-opted the party’s state leadership via mayor Rafaela Losi and secretary Fabio Bento Aguayo. Garcia alleged Moro sent his marketer to pressure former DC state president Ricardo Comyde and threatened retaliation against Governor Ratinho Júnior if he did not withdraw his candidacy. Moro dismissed Garcia as a 'folkloric figure' and denied the accusations, while Garcia tied the actions to alleged serial crimes previously reported to the STF.

item.title: PGR se manifesta contra suspensão de doações públicas com contrapartidas no defeso eleitoral
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet opposed the Novo Party's request to suspend a provision in the 2026 Budget Guidelines Law (LDO) allowing public donations with considerations during the electoral blackout period. He argued the injunction is unwarranted, as donations with burdens are already excluded from electoral restrictions under consolidated TSE jurisprudence, and the provision merely reaffirms existing legal understanding without creating a new loophole for electoral advantage.

item.title: PSDB diz ao STF desconhecer “cota de emendas” para presidência do partido
item.description: The PSDB told Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino that it is unaware of any "parliamentary amendment quota" tied to the party presidency. The statement was made in response to a July 15, 2026, order, amid investigations into potential irregularities in public fund distribution. The party says it is fully cooperating with authorities.

item.title: Zema nega ter convidado Michelle para ser sua vice
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, denied having invited Michelle Bolsonaro to be his running mate in the 2026 election. He stated he only responded to a journalist's question that mentioned her name, without having directly approached or indicated her.

item.title: Deltan pede que TRE informe a elegibilidade dele antes das eleições
item.description: Former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol (Novo-PR) filed a Request for Declaration of Eligibility (RDE) with the TRE-PR to obtain an advance ruling on his ability to run in the 2026 elections. His defense argues that the TSE's 2023 cassation of his mandate did not establish automatic ineligibility or an eight-year ban, and that all MPF disciplinary complaints were archived or prescribed. Dallagnol claims the 2023 judgment was based on 'future possibilities' that did not materialize and requests that his eligibility be assessed based on the reality of 2026.

item.title: Ibovespa anda de lado de olho em Oriente Médio, pesquisas eleitorais e balanços de big techs
item.description: The Ibovespa closed slightly down 0,03% at 173,3 thousand points, as investors remained cautious amid Middle East tensions, Brazilian electoral polls, and U.S. big tech earnings. While European and U.S. markets rose, Brazil's market lacked momentum with rising interest rates and the dollar falling to R$ 5,07. Banking stocks such as Banco do Brasil (BBAS3), Bradesco (BBDC4), Santander (SANB11) and Itaú (ITUB4) advanced, led by BBAS3's 3,52% gain.

item.title: Brasil e Coreia do Sul assinarão termos de cooperação durante visita de Lee Jae Myung
item.description: Brazil and South Korea will sign cooperation instruments in trade, technology, and innovation during the Brazil-Korea Business Roundtable in São Paulo on July 28, within the framework of President Lee Jae Myung’s official visit. The event will build on agreements initiated during Lula’s February 2026 mission to Seoul, involving key sectors such as automotive, technology, health, and heavy industry.

item.title: Caso Valdemar: PSDB diz desconhecer ‘cota de emendas’ para dirigentes partidários
item.description: The PSDB denied knowledge of any 'quota of amendments' for party leaders in response to an order from Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, who requested explanations from 21 parties regarding parliamentary amendment controls. The case stems from a Federal Police investigation into Valdemar Costa Neto, PL party president, after R$119 million in his assets were frozen over suspicions of illicit interference in fund allocation. Valdemar initially admitted influencing amendment destinations but later retracted, claiming the term 'indicates' was merely colloquial.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede observadores internacionais nas eleições
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) called for international election observers in the upcoming October elections, repeating claims about the unreliability of Brazil's electronic voting system and linking the debate to his father Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility, which stemmed from a 2022 meeting with ambassadors. He asserted that voting machines used in Brazil originate from the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, citing alleged CIA reports of vote manipulation in Venezuela's 2010 election, despite the TSE clarifying that Smartmatic does not supply technology for Brazilian electronic voting.

item.title: É falso que OAB autorizou visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: It is false that the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) authorized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The claim circulates on social media but lacks factual basis. The OAB has no authority to authorize visits to detainees or individuals under house arrest.

item.title: PDT aprova apoio a Lula, mas mantém candidatura de oposição ao PT em Minas
item.description: The PDT approved national support for Lula's re-election but decided to maintain its own candidacy for the Minas Gerais governorship with former Belo Horizonte mayor Alexandre Kalil, positioning itself in opposition to the PT in the state. The party rejected joining the Lulista ticket in Minas, stating Kalil will run 'against the PT, the PSD and whoever else has a candidate'. The convention to confirm the candidacy is scheduled for March 25 at the Minas Gerais Legislative Assembly.
